description: This Java class defines a specialized exception, ClientTransactionCannotBeUndoneException, used within the Fineract project to indicate that a client transaction cannot be reversed. It extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException and provides a specific error message for this scenario.

classes.name: ClientTransactionCannotBeUndoneException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a client transaction cannot be undone.

methods.name: ClientTransactionCannotBeUndoneException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specific error message, including transaction and client identifiers.
